title: Become More Efficient With Background Posting

chapters.title: Navigating to purchase and payable setup
Posting and printing a purchase order
Checking the report inbox for posted documents

features.name: Background posting with job queue
features.description: Allows users to post journals and documents in the background while continuing to work on other tasks, eliminating wait time during the posting process.

features.name: Post and print with job queue
features.description: Enables posting and printing of documents through the job queue with notifications delivered to the role center when documents have been posted and printed.

features.name: Report inbox for posted documents
features.description: Documents posted and printed through background posting appear in the report inbox on the role center, allowing users to access and manage posted documents in one location.

features.name: OneDrive integration for posted documents
features.description: Posted documents can be opened directly in OneDrive from the report inbox, providing cloud storage access to posted files.
caveats: Requires cloud files to be enabled for Business Central
